reasons.kind_unresolved: No WO-0 kind rule matched. The family route is fixed by the converter, but the kind needs an owner or architect call, and a family key is frozen once minted.
reasons.type_outside_family: The items.xml type is one the routed family's kind set does not express, so the family itself is contested (WO-0 remaining_unknowns: contested routes).

statement: A held id has no family key. It is listed by its existing frozen Item key only and stays a non-materializable Item record until an owner or architect call resolves it.
